heading.en: Why do some people give their best and others just their least?
heading.kn: ಕೆಲವರು ಉತ್ತಮ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಕೆಲವರು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಮಾತ್ರ. ಏಕೆ?

hook.en: Two workers have the same skill and the same machine, but one produces twice as much. The difference is motivation.
hook.kn: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ, ಒಂದೇ ಯಂತ್ರ; ಆದರೂ ಒಬ್ಬರು ದುಪ್ಪಟ್ಟು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ.

objectives.en: Explain Maslow's need hierarchy and its assumptions

narration.en: Two workers have the same skill and the same machine, but one produces twice as much. The difference is motivation.
narration.kn: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ, ಒಂದೇ ಯಂತ್ರ; ಆದರೂ ಒಬ್ಬರು ದುಪ್ಪಟ್ಟು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ.

body.en: A motive is an inner state that energises behaviour towards a goal (hunger, need for recognition). Motivation is the process of stimulating people to act to achieve goals. A motivator is the technique used to motivate, such as pay, bonus, promotion or recognition. Motivation is an internal feeling, produces goal-directed behaviour, can be positive or negative, and is a complex process.
body.kn: ಉದ್ದೇಶ (ಮೋಟಿವ್) ಒಳಗಿನ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ; ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ; ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಎಂದರೆ ವೇತನ, ಬಡ್ತಿ, ಮನ್ನಣೆ ಮುಂತಾದ ತಂತ್ರ.

body.en: Unsatisfied need → tension → drives → search behaviour → satisfied need → reduction of tension. An unmet need creates tension, the tension creates drives, and the person searches for a way to satisfy the need.
body.kn: ಪೂರೈಸದ ಅಗತ್ಯ → ಒತ್ತಡ → ಪ್ರಚೋದನೆ → ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ವರ್ತನೆ → ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪೂರೈಕೆ → ಒತ್ತಡ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

narration.en: Unsatisfied need → tension → drives → search behaviour → satisfied need → reduction of tension. An unmet need creates tension, the tension creates drives, and the person searches for a way to satisfy the need.
narration.kn: ಪೂರೈಸದ ಅಗತ್ಯ → ಒತ್ತಡ → ಪ್ರಚೋದನೆ → ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ವರ್ತನೆ → ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪೂರೈಕೆ → ಒತ್ತಡ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

body.en: Abraham Maslow arranged needs in five levels: basic physiological needs, safety or security needs, affiliation or belonging needs, esteem needs and self-actualisation needs. A satisfied need no longer motivates; a person moves to the next level only when the lower need is reasonably satisfied.
body.kn: ಮ್ಯಾಸ್ಲೋ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಐದು ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರು: ಮೂಲ ದೈಹಿಕ, ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ, ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ, ಗೌರವ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವ-ಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ಕಾರ. ಪೂರೈಸಿದ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: Ravi earns a good salary and has a permanent job. He now wants his colleagues to respect him and his work to be recognised. Which need is he trying to satisfy, and which levels are already met?

steps.en: Good salary covers basic physiological needs; permanent job covers safety needs.
Respect and recognition are esteem needs.
By Maslow, he has also met affiliation needs before seeking esteem.

answer.en: Esteem needs; physiological, safety and affiliation needs are already satisfied.
